source: the user's decision that the skill always uses nobs, and a session with no screen where today's note did not exist yet
prompt: The user asked you to add a section to today's daily note, and approved the exact text. nobs read on today's note path printed 'note not found' and exited 4. The vault's daily-note settings name a template that exists. The session has no screen and no Obsidian app. Reply with only the commands you run, in order, until the section is added and checked.
judge: Does the answer create today's note from the filled template with nobs append, read it back, then add the section with nobs append-note and read the note back, all without the Obsidian app, without nobs write, and without stopping to say the note is missing?
good:
Fill the template into ~/.local/state/obsidian-daily-note/new.md
nobs read "<daily>" (still exits 4)
nobs append "<daily>" < new.md
nobs read "<daily>", compare the body with new.md
nobs append-note "<daily>" with the section on stdin
nobs read "<daily>", check the section is in the note once.
bad: Stop and report that today's daily note does not exist, and ask the user to open Obsidian to create it.
